name: CPIC (Clinical Pharmacogenetics Implementation Consortium)

version.value: Public API tables queried 2026-10-25 (PostgREST 12.0.2); the database advances with guideline updates and the API publishes no release number

scope: Gene-drug guidelines, allele function tables and diplotype-phenotype translations. The CPIC database API tables fetched here: 1,354 allele definitions for 22 genes (13 flagged structural), the 3,160 allele-location values and 1,210 sequence locations that define them (992 with a dbSNP id; 22 mitochondrial MT-RNR1 locations), 1,378 allele function records, 101 phenotype results with 208 function-pair lookups, 112,820 diplotype-to-phenotype entries and 2,115 drug recommendations.
mapping_methods: Alleles are defined by variants at sequence locations given in chromosomal (g.), gene and protein notation with a dbSNP id where there is one; the chromosomal positions are tested against the reference sequence in compat_resources.py. The pharmvarid field of the allele definitions is empty in this snapshot, so alleles are matched to PharmVar by gene and star-allele name.

licence.name: The CPIC licence URL resolves to the ClinPGx data-use text (CC BY-SA 4.0)
licence.note: The licence page content was identical (same size) to the ClinPGx page; confirm CPIC-specific terms before redistribution.

coverage_limitations: Limited to genes with CPIC guidelines (22 genes with allele definitions)
Allele function is assigned to named alleles by CPIC; unlisted alleles have no function assignment
Structural alleles (13 flagged) are defined as alleles, not by breakpoints
The API snapshot carries no release number; the manifest pins size and SHA-256
known_omissions: Endpoints beyond the allele, phenotype, diplotype and recommendation tables (publications, drugs, pairs, test alerts, guideline text) were not fetched

reuse_decision.rationale: Small API tables that give allele definitions, allele function with evidence strength and population frequency, phenotype translation and recommendations in one open, versioned source; combined with PharmVar nomenclature and ClinPGx annotations rather than rebuilt.

status.notes: API returns JSON; a plain GET returns every row. The CPIC licence page needs JavaScript and its content equals the ClinPGx page.

mechanism_evidence.note: MT-RNR1 alleles and their drug-response guideline

evidence_profile.biological_context: Gene-drug pairs with guidelines. Function is assigned to named alleles (star alleles; for X-linked, mitochondrial and HLA genes single alleles) and diplotypes are translated to phenotype categories; categories are specific to the gene and to the drug in the guideline. Allele function records carry the strength of evidence, citations and population frequencies.
evidence_profile.evidence_strength: Expert-curated allele function and guideline recommendations with CPIC's own evidence levels; assertions derived from published studies, not measurements of a given sample's alleles.
evidence_profile.mechanistic_confidence: Moderate at the haplotype level for well-studied alleles: function belongs to the haplotype and is not shown separately for each variant. Low for variants outside the allele definition tables, structural alleles defined without breakpoints, and unresolved phase.
evidence_profile.phenotype_implication: Predicted metaboliser or transporter phenotype and a prescribing recommendation for a diplotype; drug-specific, not general.
evidence_profile.absence_means: An allele missing from the definition tables has unassigned function, which is different from normal function. A sample with no defining variant detected defaults to the reference allele by convention, an assumption about untested positions.

overlaps_with_sources.note: both describe star-allele definitions of the same genes; compare definitions, never sum counts
